changes: Right-Click Edit: Added ability to right-click and edit any saved clipboard item with a indicator icon.
Full Editor Shortcuts: Text editor now supports standard macOS keyboard shortcuts (⌘C, ⌘V, ⌘X, ⌘Z, ⌘A).
Smart Clean on Empty Edit: Completely clearing text when editing automatically deletes the clip from history.
Broader Code Detection: Enhanced categorization to recognize bash and shell scripts (cat, tail, grep, curl, etc.) with precise regex to prevent false positives on plain English text.
Fixed a bug where the keyboard shortcut badges (⌘1-⌘9) showed the wrong index.
Fixed a bug where the popover could not be dragged beyond 1000px on large displays like iMacs. It now scales dynamically.
Smart Cleanup: ClipLocal now automatically garbage collects old Universal Clipboard (Handoff) file proxy links to prevent pasting dead links.
Major performance fix: Context menus now read from a centralized O(1) cache instead of performing O(N) array calculations on every UI refresh.
UI Polish: Context menu actions (Pin/Unpin/Delete) now feature native macOS system icons.
Settings Menu Polish: The Settings menu now instantly reads counts from the centralized cache.
Added dynamic item counts to the 'Clear History' and 'Unpin All' buttons in the Settings menu.
Major Engine Overhaul: Expanding rows and scrolling is now hyper-optimized.
Introduced native NSCache for images and regex evaluations to eliminate main-thread lag.
List filtering is now cached dynamically, guaranteeing stable 60 FPS while scrolling.
Added zero-delay timestamp tracker for instant click responses.
Multiple rows can now be expanded simultaneously without UI shifting.
Popovers now reliably clear all memory states immediately upon closing.
Fixed an issue where long metadata labels (like high-res image dimensions) would wrap to a second line.
Dynamic file types: Metadata row now dynamically extracts the exact extension to display 'JPG image' or 'SRT file' instead of generic labels.
Added large image preview: clicking an image row now elegantly expands to show a full preview of the image.
Major UI enhancement for image copies: Thumbnail moved to icon position.
Smarter image titles: Automatically extracts filenames from browser copies instead of saying [Image].
Streamlined metadata text: Date format shortened and image dimensions accurately displayed on one line.
Removed 'Show image dimensions' toggle in favor of native UI display.
Fixed issue where images with extracted filenames were incorrectly filtered as text.
Clipboard items now have a stable UUID identity — no more ghost references after copying.
History now saves in the background — no more main-thread stutter on copy.
Trimming history now correctly syncs to disk immediately.
'Keep up to' limit expanded to 1,000 items.
Reducing the item limit now shows a confirmation before deleting older entries.
Copy-button checkmark no longer shows stale state when reopening ClipLocal.
'Get Started' on the About screen no longer accidentally closes the popover.
Smooth 60 fps scrolling: extracted per-row view to isolate hover-state re-renders.
Cached app icons via AppIconCache — no more repeated disk I/O per render.
Shared DateFormatter singleton to avoid expensive allocations on every row.
Replaced O(n²) firstIndex scan with O(n) enumerated index for shortcut badges.
Fixed CI build pipeline and homebrew tap workflow.
